purpose: Proposed evidence-preserving adapter contract, not an implemented protocol bridge or a wire schema

A2A_1_0.binding_discrepancy: Published spec POST subscribe vs proto GET; immediate-return summary vs default-blocking configuration. Actual adapter must freeze binding source/configuration and resolve or explicitly report this uncertainty.

DSH_WORKBENCH.note: Native interface statically reviewed; not a MCP/A2A bridge

sensitive_data_policy: Only references are recorded here. No actual tokens, bearer handles, personal messages or secret credentials in examples.

preserve: selected binding source/configuration and unresolved published-spec discrepancies
rules.mapping: Require an explicit negotiated profile. MCP per-request task capability and A2A AgentCard streaming support cannot be inferred from a previous successful call.
rules.loss: UNSUPPORTED if a required capability is absent; UNKNOWN if capability evidence is unavailable
forbid: Silent mapping of 2025 experimental Tasks fields to 2026 extension
Calling A2A v1.0 SubscribeToTask by legacy tasks/resubscribe without a 0.3 profile

preserve: separate opaque IDs and their origin
business operation key only when explicitly agreed
rules.mapping: Reference by local provider_ref plus tenant/authorization partition and raw identifier kind/value; include incarnation/generation only if known. Unknown incarnation prevents claims about reuse safety.
rules.loss: UNKNOWN incarnation, retention window or dedup scope is recorded, never replaced by a guessed global UUID equivalence
forbid: Equating session=context=task=attempt
Treating A2A messageId or JSON-RPC id as a universal business idempotency key
Publishing real bearer-capability task handles

preserve: MCP request returned ordinary tool result
workbench worker report vs local accept transition
rules.mapping: Separate terminal claim from tool/domain outcome and independent acceptance. A policy may map tool error to an A2A wrapper-task failure only with an explicit wrapper success criterion; it is not an exact status alias.
rules.loss: COARSENED for wrapper status mapping; business_acceptance=UNASSESSED without criterion/actor/artifact evidence
forbid: MCP completed always maps to A2A COMPLETED
A2A COMPLETED implies customer acceptance
workbench review implies completed

observed: external effect observation only if separately supplied
rules.mapping: MCP tasks/cancel acknowledgment confirms cancellation request acknowledgment only. A2A CancelTask returns updated state, which may or may not be terminal. Observed cancelled/canceled is a provider task claim, not rollback evidence.
rules.loss: effect_resolution=UNKNOWN absent scoped target evidence; no inferred quiescence from request completion
forbid: Fabricating A2A CANCELED from MCP empty cancel ack
Releasing action-specific resource obligation solely because cancel request returned
Treating cancel as compensation

observed: Native return branch when externally observable
preserve: Native return branch may be unknown to caller
rules.mapping: Known durable-created task handle supports polling subject to access/retention. Lost creation reply is a different case. Retry of an effectful initiating operation requires agreed idempotency, effect query or explicit risk decision; a fresh transport request ID does not supply them. A2A direct Message responses carry no implied Task handle; a bridge must not fabricate task recovery capability.
rules.loss: UNKNOWN if no handle/effect query/target dedup; Native void return has weaker public acknowledgment than a task handle
forbid: Retrying side effects simply because SSE replay is unavailable
Claiming Native duplicate return freshly flushed state
Inventing a durable task handle from an in-memory mapping

from: A2A SubscribeToTask Task snapshot + subsequent deltas
rules.mapping: A2A 1.0 subscription starts with current Task, not guaranteed full history replay; terminal tasks require GetTask instead of SubscribeToTask. 2026 MCP SSE offers no Last-Event-ID resumption. Record stores observed evidence with explicit gaps.
rules.loss: UNKNOWN completeness of missed status/history; unsupported mandatory full-log replication without additional agreed capability
forbid: Synthesizing missed event order
Treating GetTask history as a complete audit journal
Using latest remote timestamp as a global world clock

preserve: source artifact identity and append semantics
observed content digest distinct from provider id
rules.mapping: Represent artifacts as claims. lastChunk means final chunk, not proof that earlier chunks were received. A URL is a locator, not verified immutable content. Critical verification binds actual content/version and criterion outside protocol default.
rules.loss: UNKNOWN content completeness/availability after gaps; UNASSESSED validity without check
forbid: A2A artifactId equals a digest
lastChunk implies fully assembled artifact
A later URL fetch retroactively verifies the earlier accepted bytes

rules.mapping: No credential forwarding by default. AUTH_REQUIRED is a request for authorization and may be fulfilled out of band; MCP authentication is transport/resource access, not an exact-action grant. Client role does not assert a human author.
rules.loss: UNKNOWN action approval when no binding evidence; UNSUPPORTED for requested secure in-band credential delegation without negotiated mechanism
forbid: Promoting ROLE_USER or relay role=user to human authorization
Reusing approval after effectful argument changes
Forwarding original token merely because an adapter can parse it

rules.mapping: Pure translation cannot strengthen evidence. Later new evidence can resolve an unknown, but must be appended as new provenance, not attributed to an earlier acknowledgment. Required downstream guarantees missing from upstream return UNSUPPORTED; optional missing facts stay UNKNOWN.
rules.loss: Accumulate typed losses; never erase them by round-trip renaming
forbid: B UNKNOWN becomes C EXACT without new evidence
Treating conformance success as business recovery success
